title: Strength evaluation.
officialText:
If the criteria of Section 1905.6.5.4 are not met and the structural adequacy remains in
doubt, the commissioner may order a strength evaluation in accordance with ACI 318, Chapter 20, for the questionable
portion of the structure, or take other appropriate action. The registered design professional of record shall present to the
commissioner a complete analysis showing the final safe load-carrying capacity of the questionable portion of the structure
including any proposed remedial actions necessary for review and approval.
